reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: South Carolina
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: In an eviction (possession) action, can a tenant rebut/raise the defense
    that the landlord refused a voucher?

    Statutes encoded (as provided):
      - SC Code  27-40-640 (2021)  (defenses/counterclaims in certain rent/nonpayment actions; waiver rules)
      - SC Code  27-40-910 (2021)  (retaliation defense in possession actions; notice requirement)
      - SC Code  27-40-440 (2021)  (landlord duties to maintain premises / essential services)
      - SC Code  27-40-660 (2021)  (tenant remedies for unlawful exclusion / diminished essential services)

    NOTE: None of the provided statutes create a defense for "landlord refused a voucher."
*/

% -------------------------
% Basic jurisdiction facts
% -------------------------

state(south_carolina).
focus_year(2021).

% -------------------------
% Scenario facts (question statement)
% -------------------------

% Parties and action
tenant(t1).
landlord(l1).
eviction_action(a1).

% "In an eviction action" -> model as an "action for possession".
action_for_possession(a1).

% To connect with  27-40-640(a), model that the possession action is based on nonpayment of rent.
% (Even if it were not, the result below remains "no" under the provided statutes because
% voucher refusal is not an encoded statutory defense.)
possession_based_on_nonpayment_of_rent(a1).

% Tenant is in possession during the eviction action (common in eviction filings).
tenant_in_possession_during_period(t1, a1).

% Defense the tenant wants to raise
tenant_intends_defense(t1, a1, voucher_refusal).

% Factual predicate for the alleged landlord conduct
landlord_refused_voucher(l1, t1, yes).

% Rental agreement does NOT contain an obligation to accept a voucher (not stated in the question)
% so we encode it as absent, to avoid assuming extra facts.
rental_agreement_includes_voucher_acceptance(l1, t1, no).

/* Helper that succeeds exactly when the encoded scenario is satisfied. */
scenario_statement :-
    state(south_carolina),
    focus_year(2021),
    tenant(t1),
    landlord(l1),
    eviction_action(a1),
    action_for_possession(a1),
    possession_based_on_nonpayment_of_rent(a1),
    tenant_in_possession_during_period(t1, a1),
    tenant_intends_defense(t1, a1, voucher_refusal),
    landlord_refused_voucher(l1, t1, yes),
    rental_agreement_includes_voucher_acceptance(l1, t1, no).

% -------------------------
% Statute translations
% -------------------------

/* SC Code  27-40-640(a) (2021)
   In an action for possession based upon nonpayment of the rent, OR an action for rent
   concerning a period when the tenant is in possession, the tenant may rely on:
     - the rental agreement, OR
     - the provisions of this chapter
   to assert defenses and to counterclaim for any amount recoverable thereunder.
*/
statute_27_40_640_action_covered(Action) :-
    action_for_possession(Action),
    possession_based_on_nonpayment_of_rent(Action),
    !.
statute_27_40_640_action_covered(Action) :-
    action_for_rent(Action),
    rent_period_when_tenant_in_possession(Action),
    !.

statute_27_40_640_allows_defense(Action, Defense) :-
    statute_27_40_640_action_covered(Action),
    defense_based_on_rental_agreement(Defense),
    !.
statute_27_40_640_allows_defense(Action, Defense) :-
    statute_27_40_640_action_covered(Action),
    defense_based_on_chapter_provision(Defense),
    !.

/* SC Code  27-40-640(b) (2021)
   Waiver of defense based on landlord's duty to maintain premises (27-40-440 / rental agreement)
   in certain nonpayment/rent actions, if landlord lacked timely notice.
   (Encoded for completeness; not used by this voucher question.)
*/
statute_27_40_640_waives_maintenance_defense(Action, Tenant) :-
    statute_27_40_640_action_covered(Action),
    action_for_possession(Action),
    possession_based_on_nonpayment_of_rent(Action),
    defense_is_maintenance_or_habitability,
    maintenance_violation_notice_rule_triggers_waiver(Tenant, Action),
    !.

% Internal helpers for  27-40-640(b).
% We encode generic structure: waiver triggers if landlord has no notice at required time.
defense_is_maintenance_or_habitability :- true.

% If facts are missing, do not infer waiver; waiver requires actual "no notice" facts.
maintenance_violation_notice_rule_triggers_waiver(Tenant, Action) :-
    violation_type(Action, nonessential_service),
    landlord_had_notice_days_before_rent_due(_Landlord, Tenant, Action, Days),
    Days < 14,
    !.
maintenance_violation_notice_rule_triggers_waiver(Tenant, Action) :-
    violation_type(Action, essential_service_emergency),
    landlord_had_notice_before_rent_due_reasonable_opportunity(_Landlord, Tenant, Action, no),
    !.

% Default: these are not asserted in this scenario.
% (No clauses here on purpose, so queries fail unless facts exist.)

/* SC Code  27-40-910 (2021) retaliation
   Tenant can use remedies as a defense in any retaliatory action for possession.
   Tenant must notify landlord in writing within 10 days after service of the Rule to Vacate/Show Cause.
*/
statute_27_40_910_retaliation_defense_available(Action, Tenant) :-
    action_for_possession(Action),
    retaliatory_possession_action(Action, Tenant),
    tenant_gave_written_notice_of_retaliation_defense_within_10_days(Tenant, Action),
    !.

% Retaliation requires protected tenant conduct (complaint to agency or landlord about chapter/code issues)
% and a landlord retaliatory act (including bringing action for possession after such complaints).
retaliatory_possession_action(Action, Tenant) :-
    landlord_brought_possession_action_after_protected_conduct(Action, Tenant),
    !.

protected_conduct(Tenant) :-
    tenant_complained_to_governmental_agency_about_code_violation(Tenant),
    !.
protected_conduct(Tenant) :-
    tenant_complained_to_landlord_of_violation_of_chapter(Tenant),
    !.

landlord_brought_possession_action_after_protected_conduct(Action, Tenant) :-
    protected_conduct(Tenant),
    action_for_possession(Action),
    !.

% In this scenario, no retaliation-related facts are asserted, so these predicates fail by default.

% -------------------------
% SC Code  27-40-440 (2021) landlord duties (encoded as duties; not directly a voucher rule)
% -------------------------

statute_27_40_440_landlord_duty(health_safety_code_compliance).
statute_27_40_440_landlord_duty(repairs_fit_habitable).
statute_27_40_440_landlord_duty(common_areas_safe).
statute_27_40_440_landlord_duty(running_water_hot_water_heat_where_required).
statute_27_40_440_landlord_duty(maintain_facilities_and_appliances).

% -------------------------
% SC Code  27-40-660 (2021) remedies for unlawful exclusion / diminished essential services
% (remedy, not a "voucher refusal" defense)
% -------------------------

statute_27_40_660_remedy_available(Tenant) :-
    landlord_unlawfully_removed_or_excluded_tenant(_Landlord, Tenant),
    !.
statute_27_40_660_remedy_available(Tenant) :-
    landlord_wilfully_diminished_essential_services(_Landlord, Tenant),
    !.

% -------------------------
% Defense categorization / mapping
% -------------------------

/* "Defense based on rental agreement" under  27-40-640(a) */
defense_based_on_rental_agreement(voucher_refusal) :-
    % Only if the rental agreement includes an obligation to accept vouchers.
    rental_agreement_includes_voucher_acceptance(l1, t1, yes),
    !.
defense_based_on_rental_agreement(_OtherDefense) :-
    fail.

% "Defense based on provisions of this chapter" (limited to statutes encoded here)
defense_based_on_chapter_provision(retaliation) :- !.
defense_based_on_chapter_provision(maintenance_violation) :- !.
defense_based_on_chapter_provision(unlawful_exclusion_or_diminished_services) :- !.
defense_based_on_chapter_provision(_OtherDefense) :- fail.

% For this question: "voucher_refusal" is not a defense provided by the encoded chapter provisions.
defense_is_voucher_refusal(voucher_refusal) :- !.
defense_is_voucher_refusal(_Other) :- fail.

% -------------------------
% Reasoning: can tenant raise the asserted defense in this eviction action?
% -------------------------

tenant_may_raise_defense(Action, Tenant, Defense) :-
    % Route 1:  27-40-640 (nonpayment/rent actions) allows defenses based on agreement or chapter
    statute_27_40_640_allows_defense(Action, Defense),
    tenant(Tenant),
    !.
tenant_may_raise_defense(Action, Tenant, retaliation) :-
    % Route 2:  27-40-910 retaliation defense (possession action)
    statute_27_40_910_retaliation_defense_available(Action, Tenant),
    !.
tenant_may_raise_defense(_Action, _Tenant, _Defense) :-
    fail.

% -------------------------
% Final answer
% -------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    tenant_intends_defense(t1, a1, Defense),
    tenant_may_raise_defense(a1, t1, Defense),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

% -------------------------
% Main entrypoint
% -------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: In an eviction action, can a tenant rebut/raise the defense that the landlord refused a voucher?
